description: Requires a QuantGeeks plan; not available without signing in (the call asks the user to sign in) or with a free account (the call says it needs a plan). Forward expirations side by side for swing setups: the next few listed expirations, each with its primary and two major nodes, its total size in the strike window, and how its primary moved since the prior close, plus the summed book for everything within 35 days. The horizon is 35 calendar days. `expirations` is a count (default 5, at most 8) or a list of dates; `center`, or `from_strike` and `to_strike`, set the strike window (default 15 strikes each side of spot, at most 40); `date` reads a past session's close. `size` is QuantGeeks GEX (flow-based) by default; `measure` 'vex' returns VEX (vanna exposure) instead; `size_oi` is open-interest-based GEX, for comparison (GEX only). Sizes compare within one expiration. For one expiration's full ladder use quantgeeks_get_gex_ladder; for the same-day nodes over time, quantgeeks_get_node_history.

center.description: Strike the window is centered on (default: spot).

date.description: Session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern): that session's close. Default: the latest session.

expirations.description: A count of the next listed expirations (default 5, at most 8) or a list of YYYY-MM-DD dates within 35 days.

measure.description: 'gex' (default): QuantGeeks GEX (gamma exposure); 'vex': VEX (vanna exposure). Every number and node in the answer is in the measure it says.

strikes.description: Strikes on each side of the center (default 15, at most 40).

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. SPX (maps to its 0DTE option root SPXW), SPY, QQQ, VIX.

name: quantgeeks_get_expiration_map
title: Expiration map
